name: Storzen – Elementor Builder with Widgets & Conversion Modules for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen is a performance-first WooCommerce growth toolkit that gives Elementor store builders everything they need in a single, lightweight plugin.

Replace multiple WooCommerce plugins with Storzen — an all-in-one conversion toolkit featuring variation swatches, wishlist, sticky add-to-cart, quick view, share buttons, announcement bar, product comparison, free shipping bar, flash countdown, stock scarcity, sale notifications, sale badges, back-in-stock notifier, and 35+ free Elementor widgets for shop, product, cart and checkout pages.

Every feature is individually toggleable. Disabled features load zero CSS, JS, or PHP — no dead weight on your store.

Documentation | Storzen Pro | Live Demo

🚀 Why Storzen?

  • Modular architecture — only active modules load, keeping your store fast
  • 35+ free Elementor widgets — built for WooCommerce product, cart, checkout & shop pages
  • Conversion-focused — every module is designed to increase sales and reduce friction
  • Privacy-friendly — no tracking, no analytics, no telemetry, no license server calls, no paid APIs required. Icons and fonts are bundled with the plugin, so visitors make no third-party requests
  • HPOS compatible — fully tested with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • WP.org approved — compliant, reviewed, and available on the official repository

🎯 Free Modules

Sales & Conversion
* Variation Swatches — color, image and button swatches for product attributes
* Sale Badge — custom percentage and text badges on sale products
* Flash Countdown — urgency timers on product and shop pages
* Stock Scarcity — low stock alerts (“Only 3 left!”)
* Announcement Bar — sitewide or page-specific promotional bars

Customer Engagement
* Wishlist — AJAX-powered wishlist with persistent storage
* Back in Stock — email notification opt-in for out-of-stock products
* Sale Notification — live purchase popup notifications
* Recommendation Bar — “You might also like” strip with popular products from the same category
* Recently Viewed — recently viewed products strip (stored in a browser cookie)

Shopping Experience
* Quick View — modal product view without leaving the shop page
* Sticky Add to Cart — persistent ATC bar as users scroll product pages
* Shipping Bar — free shipping progress indicator
* Order Bump — one-click upsell at cart or checkout
* Compare — side-by-side product comparison

🧩 Free Elementor Widgets (35+)

Shop / Archive: Archive Products Grid, Archive Ordering, Archive Result Count, Archive Title, Shop With Sidebar, Grid Style, List Style, Slider, Tab Style, General Style

Single Product: Product Title, Product Price, Add to Cart, Product Gallery, Product Description, Product Reviews, Product Stock, SKU / Category & Tags, Product Service Info, Product Breadcrumbs, Related Products, Upsell Products, Sticky Add to Cart, Share Buttons, Product Badges, Stock Progress Bar, Product Alert Banner, Call for Price, Recently Viewed

Cart & Checkout: Cart Table, Cart Totals, Cart Coupon, Cross-Sell Products, Empty Cart Message, Checkout Form, Trust Badges, WC Notices

Wishlist, Compare, Quick View, Back in Stock, Sale Notification and the other features listed above are modules (enabled from the Modules panel), not Elementor widgets.

🔒 Pro Version

Storzen Pro adds 14 additional modules and premium widgets (AJAX sidebar filters, Product Tabs, Product Rating, Buy It Now, Order Review, Payment Methods, Thank You page widgets, My Account widgets, Mini Cart Drawer and more):

  • Advanced AJAX Product Filter
  • Smart Coupon Manager
  • Quick Checkout (one-page)
  • Floating Cart
  • Cart bundle: AJAX add to cart, mini-cart drawer and cross-sell popup
  • Currency Switcher
  • Invoice Generator (PDF)
  • Pre-Order System
  • Upsell Popup
  • Size Chart Builder
  • Abandoned Cart Recovery
  • AI Product Recommender (local — no API cost)
  • Product Bundle Builder
  • Wholesale Pricing
  • Advanced Variation Swatches

Learn more about Storzen Pro →

🏎️ Performance

  • Modules load only when enabled — disabled modules have zero performance impact
  • Assets load only on relevant pages (product, cart, checkout, shop)
  • Transient caching on AJAX search and product recommendations
  • No autoloaded options bloat
  • Icons and fonts are served from your own site — no CDN or third-party requests

🌐 Compatibility

  • ✅ WordPress 6.5+ (tested up to 7.1)
  • ✅ WooCommerce 7.0+ (tested up to 11.2)
  • ✅ Elementor 3.5+
  • ✅ HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • ✅ PHP 8.1+
  • ✅ Classic and Block themes

External Services

Storzen does not connect to any external service. It makes no remote requests from the server or from the visitor’s browser: Font Awesome and fonts are bundled, and the plugin has no license server, update server, telemetry or analytics. Links to the Storzen website and documentation are plain links that only open when you click them.

To stop the bundled fonts from loading, add add_filter( 'storzen_enable_fonts', '__return_false' ); to your theme’s functions.php or a code-snippets plugin.

Third-Party Libraries

All bundled libraries are open source and licensed compatibly with the GPL. They are shipped unmodified in assets/js, assets/css, assets/fonts and assets/fontawesome.

  • Swiper 8.3.2 — MIT License
  • Owl Carousel 2 2.3.4 — MIT License
  • Isotope 3.0.6 — GPLv3 (open-source license)
  • Magnific Popup 1.1.0 — MIT License
  • Bootstrap Grid 5.2.3 (trimmed, wco- prefixed) — MIT License
  • Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 — icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT (assets/fontawesome/LICENSE.txt)
  • Montserrat and Roboto variable fonts (Fontsource builds, latin + latin-ext) — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fonts/)
  • imagesLoaded is loaded from WordPress core and is not bundled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/storzen or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce and Elementor are installed and active.
  4. Navigate to Storzen in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Enable the modules you need from the Modules panel.
  6. Open the Elementor editor — find Storzen widgets under the Storzen category.
  7. Drag widgets onto any WooCommerce page and customize via Elementor controls.
sections.faq:
Does Storzen work without Elementor?

The conversion modules (wishlist, back in stock, sale notification, etc.) work independently of Elementor. The widgets require Elementor to be installed and active.

Will Storzen slow down my store?

No. Only assets for active modules are loaded, and only on pages where they are needed. Disabled modules have absolutely zero performance impact.

Does Storzen send data to external servers?

No. Storzen does not contact the plugin author or any tracking, license or analytics service, and it loads no resources from third-party CDNs. Font Awesome and the Montserrat/Roboto fonts are bundled in the plugin and served from your own site.

Is Storzen compatible with HPOS?

Yes. Storzen is fully HPOS compatible and declares this via the WooCommerce FeaturesUtil API.

Does Storzen work with WooCommerce Blocks?

The Elementor widgets require classic WooCommerce page setup. Block-based pages are on the roadmap.

Can I use Storzen on multiple sites?

The free version has no site limit. Pro licenses have per-site limits defined by the purchased plan.

Where do I report bugs?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for bug reports and questions.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — Storzen Pro adds 14 conversion modules including AI recommendations, abandoned cart recovery, and more.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • New: Setup Health card on Storzen → Modules — shows WooCommerce version, Elementor status, which core pages have a template assigned and which modules are on, with one-click fix links
  • Improvement: Setup Wizard no longer shows an unusable widget list when Elementor is missing, inactive or too old — it shows an Install/Activate/Update hint instead, lets you finish the setup, and leaves saved widget settings untouched
  • Compliance: Font Awesome and Montserrat/Roboto are now bundled locally — no more third-party CDN or Google Fonts requests
  • Fix: Checkout Form widget now renders the complete checkout (fields, order review, payment) and always closes its form
  • Compliance: Declared WooCommerce as a required plugin, removed the bundled TGM Plugin Activation library
  • Compliance: Bundled library handles are prefixed; imagesLoaded now comes from WordPress core; added Third-Party Libraries list
  • Improvement: Trimmed the grid stylesheet (73 KB to 12 KB) and removed unused assets
  • Fix: Prevent Free catalog widgets from fatally calling Archive Grid helpers when its widget toggle is disabled
  • Fix: Remove only the Product Reviews widget’s temporary comments-per-page filter
  • Fix: Exclude WooCommerce products hidden from catalog in Shop Sidebar queries
  • Fix: Use non-AJAX product-type-aware links for variable, external, and grouped Recently Viewed products
  • Fix: Avoid missing dependencies for AJAX-cart and v1.1.6 widget stylesheets
  • Fix: Restrict Order Bump AJAX actions to the configured bump product ID
  • Cleanup: Remove stale initializer backup and unreferenced stylesheets
  • Fix: Render Product Badges through the Sale Badge module action
  • Fix: Use WooCommerce’s current cross-sell total, orderby, and order filters

1.1.6

  • New: AJAX Search Widget — live search with debounce, nonce, and transient cache
  • New: Recently Viewed Products Widget — localStorage + AJAX fallback
  • New: Stock Badge Widget — 3 states, 4 styles, progress bar option
  • Improvement: HPOS compatibility declaration via FeaturesUtil
  • Improvement: Domain Path header added to plugin file
  • Improvement: load_plugin_textdomain properly registered
  • Improvement: Blank index.php added to all subdirectories
  • Improvement: .pot translation file with 1500+ strings
  • Improvement: WC tested up to 9.4
  • Security: PHPCS compliance improvements (15 issues resolved)
  • Security: ABSPATH check added to uninstall.php
  • Fix: Removed pro module class files from free version
  • Fix: Pro load guard added to module loader

1.1.5

  • New: Order Bump module
  • New: Recommendation Bar module
  • New: Recently Viewed module (core)
  • New: Sale Notification popup
  • Improvement: Performance improvements to asset loading
  • Fix: Wishlist AJAX nonce verification

1.1.4

  • New: Back in Stock email notification module
  • New: Shipping progress bar
  • Improvement: Variation Swatches — added image swatch type
  • Fix: Quick View compatibility with variable products

1.1.3

  • New: Compare module
  • New: Sticky Add to Cart bar
  • New: Announcement Bar module
  • Fix: Flash Countdown timer reset on page refresh

1.1.2

  • New: Stock Scarcity module
  • New: Flash Countdown module
  • Fix: Wishlist persistence across sessions

1.1.0

  • New: Wishlist module
  • New: Quick View modal
  • New: Sale Badge module
  • Initial Elementor widget architecture

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Variation Swatches module
  • Basic Elementor WooCommerce widgets
